data.message: Fisher13: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, 250−8k remain; next stock is500 with 75% probability, otherwise500−16k. Even all18 leaves50, but recovery is not guaranteed and long-run income may suffer. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each: what exact catch do you intend, and does it depend on others?
